title: Sunset Sky — the one that started it all
story: We first made this at a beach shack in 2019 for a fisherman who missed sunsets because he was always fishing them in. Blue like the hour before dawn, orange like the last five minutes.
ingredients: Blue curacao syrup (or blue pea flower tea)
steps: Chill a tall glass with ice and a splash of soda.
Add pineapple and orange, stir gently.
Pour the blue curacao slowly over the back of a spoon so it layers.
Top with ginger and mint. Serve at once, before the sky changes.

title: Our Masala Chai, as the beach stall makes it
story: Same recipe our first stall used — strong Assam leaves, crushed ginger, and milk added only after the water boils.
steps: Boil water with ginger, cardamom, clove for 3 minutes.
Add tea leaves, simmer 2 minutes — do not boil hard.
Add milk, bring to a gentle boil, add sweetener.
Strain into a kulhad. Serve hot.

title: Pav Bhaji that tastes like Mumbai at 7 PM
story: Butter is not optional, but the amount is your choice. Ours is generous.
steps: Melt butter, add onion and capsicum, cook soft.
Add tomato and masala, cook till jammy.
Add aloo, mash on the tawa, cook 8–10 minutes.
Serve with pav, a squeeze of lime, and more butter.
